delivery.title: Pworaus usun an epwe kawor - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: Ew "Pass" ikei a chok wewe ngeni pwe ewe chon angang mi kefinita a niwinsefaniti ew napanap HTTP 2xx - ese affata pwe ewe system mi angei a wesewesen isoni ika fori ewe lead. Cheki ewe mwichen ponuwen kapas eis asan ren met a wesewesen apasa; ika pwe ese wor masowan ika ew chok pwarata, ena system mei tongeni epwe angei ewe tingor nge epwe poutano ika ese ausening ngeni ewe payload non (ekkewe iten/format mi mwaken ren an API , ew kinikin mi namwot won pekin pwe ei payload ese pachenong, etc).

push.title: Webhooks mi tou - Ekkewe chon emwen & ekkewe minefo
push.intro: Unusen tongeni siwin ren ew me ew webhook : JSON , Foom (x-www-foom-urlenkode), ika omw pwisin ewe Tettenin inisumw ren <fieldkey></fieldkey> nenien nomw (awewe <example></example> ) - a angang usun omw kopwe amasoua ew cURL annuk fan ew.

api.title: Omw ewe API - Ruu-Aanen Angang ren Emon me Emon System .
api.intro: Ew me ew system mei wor omw API key mei tongeni fori, anneani me awenewena ekkewe lead me fiti ekkewe mwichen lead. Kopwe tinalo ewe kii non ewe <hdr></hdr> itelap, usun <bearer></bearer> , ika (ika ewe pisekin angang ese tongeni seti ekkewe itelap) usun <query></query> . Likitin: {{limit}} tingor non ew minich.
